name: Stockbonds: transcribe each certificate and record its company, color and shares
description: Transcribe each YUAG stock and bond certificate image and extract the company name, the certificate's color, the number of shares and whether the image is blank, as one schema-checked JSON record per image

blank_page.description: true if the image shows no certificate or no text

transcription.description: the transcribed text of the certificate, in reading order

company_name.description: the name of the company that issued the certificate

color.description: the dominant color of the certificate's printing, e.g. green, orange, brown, blue

number_of_shares.description: the number of shares as written on the certificate, or an empty string if none is given

settings.prompt:
This image is a historical stock or bond certificate from the Yale University Art Gallery.

Transcribe all of the text on the certificate, in natural reading order, keeping each line of the certificate as its own line. Transcribe the text as it is printed or written, without correcting or modernizing it.
Determine the name of the company that issued the certificate, the color of the certificate (the dominant color of its printing and border), and the number of shares it represents, as written on it. You must assign a color.
If the number of shares is not given, return an empty string for it. If the image is blank or shows no certificate, set blank_page to true and return empty strings for the other fields.

Respond only with the JSON object.

next_steps.name: one CHAI-TEA RESULT row per certificate, with its token usage
